purpose: Diagnose the unresolved local-append slowdown without changing rendering behavior.
baseline_parent: a128bb07e34cb82f00eeafc8e62a47bf7b95b128 plus same safety factory and shared probes; diagnostic changes recorded separately
scope: TileLocalRedrawTest opt-in rasterMetadataDiagnostics argument; buffered output outside timed append
fixture: Original full class including pan/zoom and 1/4/8 layer loop; unchanged deadlines and pixel assertions.
required_evidence: Frozen source hashes, exact diagnostic patch, build receipts and app/appTest APK hashes/signatures/native libs
Environment receipt immediately before and after each native phase
Raw JUnit output with metadata wall time, same-thread CPU timing validity, preparation rows/batches and query/region counts
All earlier original and four repeat samples retained; diagnostic overhead is not treated as production-off performance
non_goals: No attribution of combined admission/preparation interval solely to SQL lock wait
No physical-device or hardware screenshot claim

implementation.default: Disabled; observer captured once per rasterRegions call; no probe, clocks, records or per-row timing when null.

segments.admissionAndPreparationNanos: Repository call preparation through entry into ready SpatialIndex.read callback; includes preparation transactions, yields, Room dispatch and admission; NOT pure lock wait.
segments.queryAndDigestNanos: Ready callback entry through metadata query and digest updates, ending before original final map.
segments.hexAndResultNanos: Original final map, including SHA finalization, Formatter hex conversion and InkRasterRegion result allocation.
segments.cpu: Cumulative thread CPU, not coroutine-exclusive; emit null if endpoint Linux thread IDs differ, either sample is negative, or difference is negative.

counts.preparationRows: Sum of BuildBatch.rows; may include spatial hint/cut work and repeated identities; NOT unique stroke count.
counts.queryBatches: Calls to SpatialIndex.ink, including terminating empty query.
counts.metadataRows: Returned metadata row counts before per-row allowed/omitted filtering.
counts.nativeStrokeBuilds: Optional reflected existing lastBuild counter captured outside frame timing; baseline missing getter means omitted JSON field, NOT zero.

boundaries: Same original SHA finalization/Formatter expression and execution order; no rendering, query, cache, epoch or SpatialIndex algorithm changes.

Observer invocation only after successful SpatialIndex.read return, outside Room transaction; callback exceptions are not swallowed; production failures and cancellation propagate without emitting a success record.
Tile observer is enabled only immediately before timed local ready(), disabled in finally before forced-full rendering; callback only appends to a thread-safe CopyOnWriteArrayList.
JSON construction/status output at original end-of-case evidence point outside measured append; original fixture, class order, deadlines, assertions and dense failure are unchanged.
Diagnostic-on timings include observation overhead and must not replace default-off performance samples.
Thread endpoint identity guards CPU differences; cumulative CPU can still include other work on that thread.
This segment can identify a hex/result hotspot but cannot isolate Formatter from SHA finalization or allocation.
implementation.next_owner: Root to freeze both source trees, apply reviewed scoped patch to baseline, build and serialize opt-in native runs.
